prose: Fortune reports Rox, whose AI agents automate customer research and outreach, raised a $100M Series B co-led by General Catalyst and March Capital at a $1.3B valuation, with Sequoia and GV returning and Prosperity7 new. Founder Ishan Mukherjee previously sold Pixie Labs to New Relic for about $150M and was its chief growth officer. The pitch: CRM should put information to work, not just store it.
highlights: Agents research accounts and prep outreach
Founder sold Pixie Labs to New Relic
